rules.statement: For provision with consent, state: recipient, recipient's purpose, items provided, recipient's retention period; legal basis is recommended.

check.expr: every(rows.where(consent), r => r.recipient && r.purpose && r.items && r.retention)

rules.statement: For provision without consent, state: legal basis, recipient, recipient's purpose, items. Recipient's retention under statute is recommended where a law sets it.

check.expr: every(rows.where(!consent), r => r.basis && r.recipient && r.purpose && r.items)

rules.statement: Name each recipient (name or trade name). Do not abbreviate ("~등", "A사 등 O개사") or use generic categories (financial institutions, government agencies). Where purpose, items or period differ per recipient, show them separately.
With many recipients, the full list may be shown in a separate screen (pop-up) or a downloadable list file.
Only where the data subject can see their actual recipients through a service menu or my-page (order or booking history), the policy may give that access path plus recipient types in plain language.
Overseas third-party provision may be written in S10 marked as provision, with all S07 fields; then add a pointer here.

For a party flagged ambiguity.delegation_vs_provision (defined in S09 flags), S07 carries the provision candidate row next to the S09 outsourcing candidate. Neither is marked as chosen; the reviewer decides.

requires: link to full list with all S07 fields

options.when: subject can see actual recipients in service menu or my-page

conditionalTyping.notAllowed: Generic category without an access path showing actual recipients.

goodPatterns: Table: recipient | purpose | items | retention, with a 'details' link for long lists.

Typing example (paraphrase): recipient = 'the assigned driver', purpose = dispatch, items = pickup location, retention = until ride ends; note that the actual recipient is shown under my info > usage history.
Second table for statute-based provision: basis (PIPA article + other statute article) | recipient | purpose | items.

commonDefects.defect: Recipients not all disclosed, or written as '○○ 등' / '제휴사'.
A required field missing (e.g. recipient's retention period).
Outsourcing (위탁) listed as third-party provision or the reverse.
Recipient typing used without a my-page path that shows actual recipients.
